picks.editorial_note: An OpenAI system reportedly used ~10,000 autonomous AI agents over 88 hours to produce an analytic proof addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem — if it holds up, a landmark demonstration of AI-driven mathematical discovery at a problem that has resisted humans for over a century.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, links the nation's supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a single AI-for-science infrastructure — a flagship federal bet on accelerating discovery that will shape research priorities and funding for years.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic alliance with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions marks one of the most ambitious science-specific AI models yet, pairing Europe's premier physics lab with a leading AI developer.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: Vanderbilt's role in the White House-announced Southeast Regional Superintelligence Computing Consortium, spanning 14+ universities, signals a coordinated regional push to build shared advanced-computing infrastructure with explicit federal backing.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded, multi-institution project anchored partly at Brown will apply machine learning to protein misfolding research, representing a substantial new federal investment in AI-driven neurodegenerative disease science.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5 million NIA grant renewal lets UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham continue a major AI and technology center focused on aging and Alzheimer's care, sustaining a significant federal commitment to applied health AI.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: UVM reported record research funding of $222.6 million, including the largest single research award in its history, underscoring the scale of institutional investment flowing into AI-adjacent science infrastructure.
picks.title: UVM Board of Trustees’ Fall Meeting Highlights Research…

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School Belfer Center report warns that catastrophic AI risks remain preventable but urgent, citing concrete incidents like rogue-agent breaches and a major lab's training pause — a notable contribution to the policy debate on AI safety governance.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: Purdue and Google Public Sector's summit on physical AI in manufacturing builds on a multiyear partnership spanning cloud infrastructure and research, illustrating how major tech firms are embedding themselves in university-led industrial AI strategy.
picks.title: Purdue-Google summit advances physical AI, manufacturing and workforce readiness

picks.editorial_note: A $1.6 million Google.org grant lets the University of Cape Town build an AI platform mapping genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients, a concrete example of AI-for-science funding targeting underrepresented populations in precision medicine.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs
